idea-plugin.name: ML Experiment Cockpit
idea-plugin.description:
ML Experiment Cockpit — browse your MLflow experiments, runs, metrics and Model Registry models directly inside the JetBrains IDE.

Connects to a running MLflow Tracking Server, an Optuna Dashboard and the W&B GraphQL API, and surfaces experiment / run / study / trial / sweep / model-registry metadata directly inside the IDE. Built for ML engineers who already use MLflow, Optuna or W&B and want the IDE to see their experiments and registered models instead of switching to a browser tab.

  • MLflow: browse experiments and runs, params, metrics and metric charts.
  • MLflow Model Registry: list registered models and their versions.
  • Optuna: browse studies and trials from an Optuna Dashboard.
  • W&B Sweeps: list sweeps by state with their run count (read-only, W&B API key).

Open it from the ML Experiment Cockpit tool window; configure servers in Settings | Tools | ML Experiment Cockpit.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.0.16 — Complete axis labels in the metric chart.

  • The X-axis labels of the metric chart are no longer cut off: the last step label ("step 39") is now fully visible instead of being truncated to "step".
  • The chart keeps a right margin, so the curve no longer runs into the edge of the panel, and the Y-axis has enough room for values in scientific notation.
  • The "N point(s) for <metric>" caption no longer touches the right border of the panel.
